newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bond real returns rise at 3, 5 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bond real returns rise at 3, 5 yrs.

text.p: Rates on three- and five-year Mexican UDI bonds rose at Tuesday's primary auction.
The 1,078-day UDI bond was assigned at a price of 98.86777 UDIs and a rate of 6.42 percent, and the 1,806-day UDI bond returned 6.48 percent at a price of 97.96464 UDIs.
Two weeks ago the three-year UDI bonds had a real return of 6.22 percent and the five-year paper, 6.30 percent.
Demand for three-year paper this week was 829.13 million UDIs compared to 500 million UDIs on offer, and for five-year paper it was 626.06 million UDIs with 250 million UDIs offered.
